name: Ajiki Tooko
source:
A girl of charming, diligent, and compassionate nature, recognized for her sincerity. 
As the village chief's daughter, Tooko is perpetually mindful of the community's needs, honoring all its traditions. Nonetheless, the village's mistreatment of women distresses her.

She's a bride candidate for the village festival held every 20 years.

[Translated from the [url=http://clockup.net/erewhon/character.html#char01]official website[/url]]

[spoiler]Tooko is actually [url=https://vndb.org/c74628]Midori[/url]'s daughter. She was changed places with [url=https://vndb.org/c69405]Sae[/url] by [url=https://vndb.org/c129717]Masa[/url], who was saved by [url=https://vndb.org/c74628]Midori[/url] in the past, in order to get revenge for her.[spoiler]
